ExternalRDProStyleCreate.description:
Public API schema for creating styles from the RD Pro user template.

Only fields exposed by the RD Pro template are accepted.

llm_instructions.default: Adding missing details like subjects, themes, or a background. Always make sure some kind of background is described, it can be blank or have content.
llm_instructions.title: Llm Instructions

reference_images.description: Exactly one base64-encoded reference image is required.
reference_images.title: Reference Images

user_prompt_template.default: Pixel art styled {prompt}, with 1px outlines and detailed textures.
user_prompt_template.title: User Prompt Template

ExternalRDProStyleCreate.title: ExternalRDProStyleCreate

ExternalRDProStyleUpdate.description:
Public API schema for updating styles created from the RD Pro user template.

All fields are optional and limited to RD Pro editable fields.

reference_images.description: Replace the style reference with exactly one base64-encoded image. Omit or use null to keep the current reference.
reference_images.title: Reference Images

ExternalRDProStyleUpdate.title: ExternalRDProStyleUpdate

ExternalStyleCreateResponse.description: Minimal response model for public API style creation.
ExternalStyleCreateResponse.title: ExternalStyleCreateResponse

ExternalStyleDeleteResponse.description: Minimal response model for public API style deletion.
ExternalStyleDeleteResponse.title: ExternalStyleDeleteResponse

ExternalStyleSelectorItem.description: Public API style metadata tailored for API and MCP clients.
ExternalStyleSelectorItem.title: ExternalStyleSelectorItem

ExternalStyleSelectorResponse.description: Response model for public API style discovery.
ExternalStyleSelectorResponse.title: ExternalStyleSelectorResponse

animation.description: Name of an existing animation on that version to change instead of adding a new one. It keeps its name; the prompt describes what should change.
animation.title: Animation

prompt.description: The motion to add (or the change to make), up to 250 characters.
prompt.title: Prompt

animation.description: Which animation, for the gif, sheet and mp4 targets. Omit it for gif or sheet to get every animation in one zip.
animation.title: Animation

input_palette.description: A palette image (base64 PNG, JPEG or WEBP, like input_palette on /inferences): the model is built with only its colors (up to 256; larger images are reduced). Revisions and animations keep the palette.
input_palette.title: Input Palette

prompt.description: What to build, up to 250 characters.
prompt.title: Prompt

reference_images.description: Up to 4 base64 images (PNG, JPEG or WEBP).
reference_images.title: Reference Images

size.description: Cube size in texels (16, 32, 64, 128, 256) or 'auto'. Auto reads the prompt; requests with only reference images default to 64.
size.title: Size

style.description: A Low-Poly style id from GET /lowpoly/pricing (rd_lowpoly__detailed, rd_lowpoly__blocky, ...).
style.title: Style

LowPolyRecolorInput.description: The image canvas's color tools, applied to a 3D model's texture atlas. Saves a new version.

color_count.description: color_reducer: how many colors (omit for automatic).
color_count.title: Color Count

dither_mode.description: color_reducer / palette_converter: ordered dithering between the new colors.
dither_mode.title: Dither Mode

tool.description: color_reducer (limit the colors), palette_converter (convert to a palette image) or color_style_transfer (take a reference image's color style).
tool.title: Tool

LowPolyRecolorInput.title: LowPolyRecolorInput

prompt.description: What should change, up to 250 characters.
prompt.title: Prompt

prompt.description: How to split, up to 250 characters (optional). Without one, every separate object that makes sense becomes its own model.
prompt.title: Prompt

pieces.description: split: the new models, one per object (each is also a new history item).
pieces.title: Pieces

scene_url.description: Viewer payload (JSON) for the interactive 3D view.
scene_url.title: Scene Url

NeoArtStyleType.description: Types of Neo Art Styles for differentiation and filtering
NeoArtStyleType.title: NeoArtStyleType

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds for the latest status update.
updated_at.title: Updated At
